clinical_finding: High sensitivity but catastrophic false alarm rate (1,946.56 FA/24h) due to missing spatial context.
Spatial GNN filtering suppresses false alarms by 89.7% (200.39/24h) and slashes parameters by 70%, but isolated spatial windows lack temporal evidence integration.
Causal GRU temporal sequence memory restores event sensitivity to 95.45% (21/22), cuts FA/24h by another 68.7% (62.66/24h, -96.8% vs CNN), and skyrockets AUPRC to 0.8068.
